title: Rhubarb Jubilant Soup
description: A sweet and tangy soup made with rhubarb and jubilant flavors, perfect for a warm evening.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Broth
ingredients.notes: chicken or vegetable broth can be used

instructions: Heat the Syrian Soup Mix in a large pot according to the package instructions.
Add the cut rhubarb to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the vegetable broth and jubilant to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
